reasons.release_qualifier: osv-scanner takes the release from the purl qualifier distro=debian-12.8 as the ecosystem Debian:12.8, which no OSV record names (Debian records name Debian:12); with only that qualifier rewritten to debian-12, osv-scanner reports this advisory too
reasons.source_package: the Debian binary package is built from a source package of another name, which Syft records in the purl's upstream qualifier; Debian advisories name the source package, the matcher looks the source up and osv-scanner looks up the binary name
reasons.placeholder_version: Syft could not resolve this version (pom.xml takes it from a parent BOM that is not read), wrote UNKNOWN as the component version and left the purl without one; osv-scanner compares the word UNKNOWN as a version, the matcher does not match a package with no version
reasons.withdrawn: the advisory is withdrawn; the matcher drops it, osv-scanner still reports it
reasons.ghsa_copy_differs: the GHSA repository holds a newer version of this advisory than OSV's all.zip, and the two versions disagree on this package version
reasons.version_scheme_edge: the version or a range bound does not parse in the ecosystem's scheme in univers, so the matcher skips the range (Q06) where osv-scanner's own parser reads it
reasons.missing_purl: the component has no package URL (Q07), so the matcher cannot key it
